template.name: Social feed — Decipher
template.description: Facebook-style native ad-testing feed with original photo assets, fictional profiles, likes, numeric legacy visible time plus 1%/50% full-card cumulative exposure and quality states, assigned from a tab-delimited design file.
template.instructions: Use SocialFeed for each task of this 5-feed, 20-post design. Put tasks 1 through 5 once each, in order, in main. Each component includes its own suspend: one component per page. The base owns the single shared CSS/JS pair (including the timing engine), .dat loader, original text/image references, persistent assignment questions and automatic initialization step. Photos load progressively from survey static files with reserved media space; do not embed repeated base64 photos or wait for all images. Preserve all of these. Upload the bundled social-design.dat as a root/system file and all public JPEG files to the survey static folder before compiling XML. Never replace it with browser randomization. Keep native Feed/task and Offer/task labels, fixed response codes 1/2/3, native Continue, zero-like validity and the legacy revision-4 timing rule plus ExposureRevision 1 full-card 1%/50% fields (anyms, halfms, exposurestate), Time/task numeric fields, availability states and creative/context metadata. Visible time is not attention. Retain fictional author/avatar/timestamp rows, Sponsored labels, photo assets, clear ad offers and the blue thumb Like control. Require photo readiness before timing. Do not add real social accounts or dead comment/share/shop controls. Do not add a marketing shell, welcome/review pages, comment/share/composer controls or extra substantive questions. Keep the concise question/instructions and neutral Continue. Do not duplicate task numbers. The universal Questra theme owns the survey frame and common controls; feed styles and placeholders stay scoped to the component. Preserve native navigation; the shared theme intentionally omits progress visualization. Existing native questions can share a feed page when deliberately placed before its suspend; do not add questions to the demo without authorization. The only input is task; other designs, counts, copy/image resources or schema changes require regeneration and native verification. Treat the provided design as a synthetic example, not a statistically optimized experiment.
